description: This file contains shell script code for testing the '--anchored' option of the 'git diff' command. It sets up various test cases to verify the behavior of anchored diff options, including multiple anchors, nonexistent lines, non-unique lines, overriding arguments, and integration with other git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks for the correct exit status.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs commands expecting a specific exit code, helping verify correct behavior of the diff under various options.
